summary: TypeScript request cancellation and collection readiness framing

schema.detail: No database schema or migration changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordinated member upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: Adds exported RequestOptions with an optional AbortSignal to HTTP methods, including generated methods. Existing arguments remain in place. Collection onOpen runs once before buffered commands flush; commands issued there follow earlier commands. Known collection frame envelopes are validated before onFrame, while rows and unknown kinds remain raw.

downtime.detail: No additional restart or interruption required.

manual.detail: Existing callers need no changes. Cancellation does not prove an action was not delivered and does not retry it.

recovery.detail: No stored-state recovery changes. Callback failures close the collection socket and reach onEnd once.
